steps.description: QA conducts sign-off on a successful staging run in parallel with the Security scan.

evidence.quote: Production deployments require QA sign-off on a successful staging run and a Security scan with no critical findings before deployment may proceed. QA review and the Security scan run in parallel.

steps.description: Security performs a scan for critical findings in parallel with QA review.

evidence.quote: QA review and the Security scan run in parallel.

steps.description: The critical security finding is remediated and a clean scan result is obtained before deployment may proceed.

evidence.quote: If the Security scan identifies a critical finding, the deployment is blocked until the finding is remediated and a clean scan result is obtained.

steps.description: On-call engineer availability is confirmed before the production deployment proceeds.

evidence.quote: Confirmation of on-call engineer availability is required before any production deployment.

steps.description: Deploy to production within the approved change window after all pre-deployment checks pass.

evidence.quote: The deployment must occur within the approved change window.

steps.description: On-call engineer executes the rollback procedure within 30 minutes of the failure being declared.

evidence.quote: If a deployment fails, the on-call engineer must execute the rollback procedure within 30 minutes of the failure being declared.
